lines: I'm on my ninth life. Want to know what happened to the other eight?
One. Egypt. They worshipped me. The crocodile didn't.
Two. A Viking ship. I chased a fish. Overboard.
Three. China. I napped in a fireworks shop.
Four. Pirates. I ate the captain's parrot.
Five. Paris. I climbed the Eiffel Tower. Forgot about down.
Six. I snuck onto a rocket. Space has no fish.
Seven. A scientist put me in a box. Long story.
So now... I'm being very, very careful.
